about: Paid placements (sponsored spots) per city, read by js/sponsored.js. Types: featured = one card at the top of the city's place list; tile = one card after the 6th place in the list; event = one of the place's upcoming events shown first in Events. Every spot carries a visible 'Sponsored' label. An entry is only shown from start to end (YYYY-MM-DD, both included, Brussels date), when its place exists in that city, is open and passes the guide's rules (no chains, fast food, pizza, kebab or burgers; check with python3 scripts/check_sponsored.py). Several active entries of one type: one per day, in turn. Optional: tagline (text, or {en, nl, de, fr, es}); for an event, 'event' = the start of the event title (otherwise the place's next event). demo: true = preview only, shown only with ?sponsored=demo in the URL, never in production. Add a sponsor: one line under its city, e.g. {"id": "<place id>", "type": "featured", "start": "2026-12-01", "end": "2026-12-31", "tagline": "…"}.
